# Theory: Git Storage is Packs Plus a Database of Metadata

Repo growth hurts fetch time, `gc`, and inode counts. The forge DB (users, issues) scales on a different axis than packfiles.

## Invariants

1. Local disk vs NFS vs Ceph vs S3 changes latency of `git fetch`.
2. Gitaly-style git servers shard repos, not tables.
3. CDNs help clone of *public* objects; auth still hits origin.

```text
packfiles / alternates / object storage
metadata DB  (issues, users)   separate scale plan
```

## What can break

- NFS for lots of tiny Git objects without cache.

## How to read this chapter

Growth, storage options, fetch, DB, CDN/geo, benchmarks.
